mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, password, email, user_type, real_name, phone_number, avatar_url, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{userType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{realName}, #{phoneNumber}, #{avatarUrl}, #{isActive}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET username = #{username}, password = #{password}, email = #{email}, user_type = #{userType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, real_name = #{realName}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, is_active = #{isActive}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET is_active = NOT is_active, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
